title: Salmon Cubes
description: This mod adds salmon cubes, salmon blocks and a fishgun. Have fun?
body: A silly little mod. Most importantly adds salmon cubes obtainable from raw salmon. Also adds salmon cube piles and blocks and a fishgun. FISH![Content in Salmon Cubes currently](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f720c1102afd6b355f26381e4b7fab88e40fe85.png)
